findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "document_text" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "documents" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract, extract_rendered, pdf_text, document_text · Private data: pdf_text, document_text, document_extract · Public sink: document_text, document_extract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract, extract_rendered, pdf_text, document_text · Private data: pdf_text, document_text, document_extract · Public sink: document_text, document_extract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
